comment: Professor was great. The class size is small and the content can be a little challenging but this turned out to be one of my favorite classes for the semester. The professor is writing his own textbook and Apple App for the class to use but I find the lectures do a better job of explaining the content.
Ori Belkind is a solid teacher. Some complain but they complain on subject matter. He made my year brighter.
TERRIBLE.  Expect to need an outside tutor.

Worthless!  Disorganized teaching and notes.  Few examples to do the work which is graded for correctness.  Tests and quizzes are too long.  Gives attitude when students ask for help.  Always late to class and held students late every class.  The class average grade for the final exam was "F" and he was out of the country to help students to study.

If you understand the material, you will do well. Ori is very friendly, but sometimes doesn't tell you everything you need to know for the homework. The homework is graded so that you can miss about 3 problems and still get an A. The tests cover only material we covered in class, no surprises.

elementary symbolic logic. either you get it or you don't. belkind knows what he is talking about and is helpful during office hours. four tests and a final. two hard tests, two easier. rarely curves. homework due for every class. if you are like me and do not naturally pick it up then drop it ASAP

good: office hours, sense of humor.                                                                           bad/irritating: some awkward explanations, difficult exams, goes 3-5 minutes over class time, every time. taking it just for the gen. ed requirement? don't.

Belkind is knowledgeable and smart, and has a good sense of humor to boot. He is not at all presumptuous, but students can ask questions about many fields and reasonably expect a good answer. His teaching style and personality help make a potentially boring class more interesting. Definitely a worthwhile professor to take.
This isn't a comment on the professor so much as the class. If you're struggling with it and have the opportunity to withdraw, do it.

Considering it was a subject matter I sucked at, the class was very interesting. Never got bored nor shot down for stupid questions. Dr. Belkind was very helpful especially during office hours. Not a bad class to take!

TAKE HIS CLASS. Ori Belkind is a really nice guy with a bit of a funny accent but he is still a great teacher. He is very willing to accept others opinions and he never once shot anyone down. Class is engaging and virtually centers around class discussions. If you dont show up every now and then he wont really care.
An excellent professor. He knows the material, and is able to teach it very well. He's an extremely fair grader, and keeps class interesting with his humor.
